{{hatnote|For the Yavin 4 locations, see [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]] and [[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room.]}}
'''Massassi Training Temple''' is a YouTube channel created by [[Andrew Davis]] covering the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game.<ref name="ht-davis" /><ref name="ch" /> The first video, ''Ep. 1 The Naboo League'', was posted on 8 January 2022.<ref name="ep1" /> Davis named it after the Massassi temples on Yavin 4 in the old Star Wars canon.<ref name="ht-davis" /> He said "the name comes from my love of the old books where Luke … the Jedi training temple and stuff on Yavin 4".<ref name="ht-davis" />

The channel posted reviews, game commentary, a "School for Younglings" series, MTT News, live streams, and coverage of Naboo Regionals, including games and player interviews from 2022 and 2023.<ref name="ch" /><ref name="ep52" /><ref name="news" /> Davis described the work as content for ''Star Wars'' CCG players.<ref name="ht-davis" /> On 15 October 2026 the uploads list held 68 videos.<ref name="ch" /> The latest public upload is dated 24 September 2023.<ref name="g6" />

[[Dan Tartaglione]] interviewed Davis on [[Holotheatre]] on 23 November 2022 (season 3 episode 47, ''Back to School with Massassi Training Temple'').<ref name="ht-davis" /> Tartaglione introduced him as "the host, the lead guy, the creator of the Massassi Training Temple on YouTube".<ref name="ht-davis" />
